title: Lock the camera/motion in Blender using the Higgsfield plugin before generating…
content:
Lock the camera/motion in Blender using the Higgsfield plugin before generating to keep fight choreography and camera moves consistent.

Animate the locked-motion shot using Seedance 2.5 to produce the final AI video with controlled camera movement.
